status: independent numerical cost audit; no arithmetic changed

source_findings.layer_norm: norm_fp32.cc calls pinned layer_norm_f32_impl: FP32 two-pass statistics and scalar_invsqrt; it is not an FP64 statistics path.
source_findings.prepare_key_norm: stages_fp32.cc accumulates 64 squared FP32 products into double and calls seven-iteration double root.
source_findings.finish_group_norm: stages_fp32.cc uses double mean/centered variance/root and FP32 affine/residual outputs.
source_findings.sigmoid_decay: vector_exp_fp32.hpp has FP32 range reduction and seventh-order polynomial; native scalar reciprocal per element and scalar fallback below -69.
source_findings.recurrence_state: FP32 update and persistent state; untouched.
source_findings.compiler: rwkv7_common.py explicitly sets -fno-fast-math, -ffp-contract=off and __AIE_API_FP32_EMULATION__=1. This is not evidence for native FP32 vector multiply throughput.

object_evidence.scope: Undefined helper references in local production build objects; not dynamic cycle counts or a re-extraction of the currently loaded xclbin.
object_evidence.update: rwkv7_stage_recurrent.o has no undefined helper symbols in this inspection.

cost_evidence.prior_region_trace: rwkv7-prepare-region-profile-2026-10-03.json and rwkv7-sigmoid-batch-progress-2026-10-03.json; independently instrumented windows must not be summed as total production cycles.
cost_evidence.rejected_root: rwkv7-root-fixed-point-rejected-2026-10-03.json; bitwise early exit did not prove model gain. Do not repeat unchanged.

decision: Keep all numerical contracts. FP64-to-FP32 statistics, reduction reordering, approximate math or activation quantization require an independent path with thresholds fixed before measurement. No numerical rewrite justified by these host wall times.
